Here’s a quick, tasty weeknight dinner you can whip up in about 30 minutes:

**One‑Pan Lemon‑Herb Chicken & Veggies**  
*Source:* Allrecipes – “One‑Pan Lemon Herb Chicken and Vegetables” (https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/236002/one-pan-chicken-and-veggies/)  
*Summary:* Season bone‑in chicken thighs with lemon zest, garlic, rosemary, thyme, salt and pepper; surround them with baby potatoes, carrots, and broccoli florets tossed in olive oil. Roast everything together on a sheet pan at 425 °F for 25‑30 minutes until the chicken is golden and the vegetables are tender. One pan means minimal cleanup, and the bright lemon‑herb flavor makes it feel special without extra effort.

**Why it works for a weeknight:**  
- Prep time ≈ 10 minutes (just chopping and seasoning).  
- Cook time ≈ 25 minutes, hands‑off while it roasts.  
- Uses common pantry staples and a single baking sheet, so cleanup is fast.  

Feel free to swap the veggies for whatever you have on hand (zucchini, bell peppers, or sweet potatoes work great).
